title: Is Dark Matter Really Matter?
summary: In the standard model of cosmology, it is assumed that dark matter is pressureless with equation of state $w=0$ and dark energy has $w=-1$. We test these assumptions jointly using DESI DR2 distance measurements, including the recent Lyman-$α$ full-shape Alcock-Paczynski (AP) information, DES supernovae, and two complementary CMB treatment. When constant $w_{dm}$ and $w_{de}$ are varied together, we find $w_{dm}=0.000968^{+0.000501}_{-0.000496}$ and $w_{de}=-0.9380^{+0.0259}_{-0.0262}$ (68%).
